name: Shore House at The Del
insider_take: This oceanfront gem sits on one of America's most pristine beaches, where the Hotel del Coronado has been Hollywood's playground since 1888.
whats_special: Shore House offers an intimate boutique experience within the legendary Hotel del Coronado complex, combining modern luxury with Victorian elegance. The property sits on Coronado Beach, consistently ranked among the world's best beaches for its unique sparkling sand caused by mica mineral deposits.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner reservation early - Coronado Beach faces due west, offering some of Southern California's most spectacular ocean sunsets with unobstructed Pacific views.
dont_miss: The famous ghost tours of the historic Hotel del Coronado next door, where Marilyn Monroe filmed "Some Like It Hot," and the charming Coronado Ferry ride offering stunning San Diego skyline views across the bay.
pros: Iconic beachfront location on Coronado Beach
Historic charm with modern luxury amenities
Multiple dining venues and world-class spa
cons: Historic building may have smaller room layouts
